public_payload.normalized_proposition: Neoclouds and hyperscalers have over $374 billion in construction-in-progress assets, of which an estimated $200 billion or more are GPUs.

statement.excerpt: As I discussed a few weeks ago, neoclouds and hyperscalers have over $374 billion in “construction in progress” assets, and I estimate that $200 billion or more of them are GPUs, primarily from NVIDIA.

our_interpretation: The total is an asset stock, not accumulated capital expenditure or future purchase commitments.

The referenced earlier analysis uses companies' latest disclosed balances at different dates, including Amazon's year-end 2025 balance. The target period covers those reporting dates rather than imposing a common quarter-end.

The referenced population includes Alphabet, Meta, Oracle, Amazon, SpaceX, Tesla, CoreWeave, IREN, Core Scientific and Applied Digital. Its GPU estimate also introduces assumptions about additional companies and balances.
The GPU subtotal must distinguish GPUs from TPUs, networking, complete servers, buildings and other infrastructure. 'I estimate' permits an uncertainty range, but still requires a defensible method.
criteria.support_condition: A reproducible, nonduplicated aggregation of the relevant disclosed balances exceeds $374 billion, and an independently defensible asset breakdown supports at least $200 billion of GPUs, predominantly NVIDIA products.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A sufficiently complete, comparable accounting establishes a total no greater than $374 billion or a GPU component below $200 billion. A smaller sample or missing breakdown is not a contradiction.
